cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Believe This with Me
cards.instruction: Recruit someone into treating your impossible explanation as the most useful version of events.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. The house is migrating south. Help me redirect it before we lose the driveway. Please.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The surveyor says subsidence. He's bringing concrete.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. Concrete traps it halfway across the road. Tell him we're planning a route.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: His truck's blocking the road already.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Perfect. Ask him to lead slowly toward the empty plot. It needs a guide.
